eventDetail.scope: Our conference covers a comprehensive spectrum of cutting-edge topics in electronics and information engineering. Areas include semiconductor and device technologies, signal processing, communications, computer and information systems, system and control engineering, and emerging technologies such as biomedical electronics, bioengineering, and IT convergence. By bringing together leading researchers and industry professionals, the conference fosters the exchange of innovative ideas, promotes interdisciplinary collaboration, and advances technological progress to address current and future challenges across these fields.
